text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heheh. Look at me shakin' like a leaf in the wind. It's like I've lost control of my entire body!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, this isn't the time for jokes. As if the great Inari would chicken out before a festival!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'm so ready to go, I can barely hold it in!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm gonna make sure you're the first to taste sweet victory! So don't you dare go anywhere!
